most_likely: Multiple displaced right rib fractures with flail chest from blunt chest trauma
summary: Cachectic middle-aged man with IVDU on methadone and PTSD presented after a mechanical fall in the bathtub, striking his right lateral chest, with multiple displaced right 4th–11th rib fractures (flail segment), small right traumatic pneumothorax/hydropneumothorax and extensive subcutaneous emphysema, managed with pigtail thoracostomy. Course was complicated by aspiration/multifocal pneumonia (heavy Haemophilus influenzae, beta-lactamase positive, in sputum), fever and hypotension requiring pressors, and acute hypoxemic respiratory failure requiring intubation (self-extubated), plus new paroxysmal atrial fibrillation with RVR requiring IV metoprolol/diltiazem then oral beta-blockade. He also developed volume overload with bilateral pleural effusions and peripheral edema responsive to IV furosemide; TTE showed preserved LVEF 65% with mild-moderate MR. He was weaned off oxygen and discharged to complete Augmentin, continuing methadone and gabapentin.
